scope: Windows 11 x64 build 26300, native desktop with a test identifier, disposable local directories and loopback model endpoints

tests.modelFormats: tools/ai_api_smoke.cjs --workbench: OpenAI Completions, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic Messages

observations: The native selector displayed all eight presets. The loopback project request carried only manual skills until opt-in. The enabled role added its compiled recommendations in order within the four-slot budget.

Changing the recommendation switch revoked an already-pending plan. Switching away and back while the auto-mode request was in flight preserved the answer and original role label, discarded the native plan and left its target file absent.

The review role locked permissions to read-only. Terminal advice sent no directory listing or tools, and leaving that role retained read-only mode with project tools off. The two folders and a new conversation had independent choices.

Frontend tests held both a profile refresh and an already-submitted execution open across role changes. Rust tests checked four manual skills, disabled user skills, duplicate recommendations, profile preservation and direct IPC role restrictions.
